text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Unbelievable!? Meisho Doto
claims victory over T.M. Opera O!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
The late-blooming, hardworking Umamusume
has just shown a glimpse of her dormant talent!!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
O-Ohhh... So this is a revolution...
To think they'd actually pull it off...

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
To think the day would come when Cinderella's blade
would pierce the prince through the back...!
(Slash!)

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Maria! Adieu!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: ...I don't know who you are, but—!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Hyauuu, Opera O-san,
I'm so sorry, so sorry~.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Bwahahaha, think nothing of it, Doto.
A prince might fall at once, but I am the Supreme Overlord!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
As if I would fall from a single act of defiance.
Besides—

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
The cause of defeat is abundantly clear, after all.
Wouldn't you agree, Trainer?

Looking around, the Umamusume who had run alongside TM Opera O
were glaring at her with murderous eyes.

Today's marking was out of the ordinary.
Having such a target on my back is tough after all...

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"Even so, that's my problem.
It has nothing to do with you, Doto."

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"So, Doto. What will you do from here on?
Isn't it about time you made your stance clear?"

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
A night...? (knight)
Opera O-san, what's a knight...?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
It means you need to make your allegiance crystal clear.
We've gotten along well enough up until now, but...

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: "Taking this victory as your cue, do you intend to stand alongside me as my 'lifelong rival'?"

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
If that's the case,
I'll properly treat you as a formidable rival.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: In exchange for showing respect—I'll stop going easy on you. Showing sympathy to the strong would be an insult, after all.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Come, O Doto, tell me
of the path you shall conquer.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
The path I must walk...
Will make me... Opera O-san's enemy...?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: I'd always wanted to run together with you, but...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Does that mean... we'll be enemies?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Springing that on me so suddenly... auugh...

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, it seems you cannot make up your mind.
We can leave it for now, then.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Doto. As I declared, my next step
forward shall be to the Japan Cup.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Think carefully until then. Consider whether
you truly want to become my lifelong rival or not.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Let's go, Trainer-kun.

Without sparing a single glance at the glaring
Umamusume, T.M. Opera O departed the track.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Well, Doto still has areas to work on,
but so do we, Trainer-kun.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Being marked so heavily,
I can't even run like an "Overlord."
Now then, what should I do...?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
From here on, in every race,
we will be surrounded by enemies on all sides...

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
To think that I must run while completely
surrounded by La Marseillaise on all sides.
choice_data_list: But you have no intention of giving up, do you?
But you're not giving up, are you?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha, so you saw right through that too. Of course.
The path a king charges through—the royal road—is bound to be fraught with hardship!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: As the "Supreme King," one must be a figure capable of overcoming such walls.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Alright, let us deliberate before autumn. Together,
we will surely overcome this hardship, Trainer-kun.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: "And at the Japan Cup, let us show the world a performance befitting the monarch of this country!"

The "Overlord Encirclement" Grass Wonder spoke of
had finally become a tangible threat.
To establish a dynasty—we must somehow find a way to break through the encirclement.
